cases.title: list carries both stores: live and history
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert {'live','history'} <= set(d); assert {'count','profiles','providers','items'} <= set(d['live']); assert d['history']['available'] is True"

cases.title: history reports a real total
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); h=d['history']; assert h['total']>0; assert len(h['conversations'])<=int(h['filter']['per'])"

cases.title: default order is newest activity first
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=20' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ls=[c['last_at'] or '' for c in d['history']['conversations']]; assert ls==sorted(ls, reverse=True), ls[:4]"

cases.title: page count matches the total
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=20' | python3 -c "import sys,json,math; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d['history']['filter']; assert f['pages']==max(1,math.ceil(f['total']/20)), (f['pages'],f['total'])"

cases.title: consecutive pages do not overlap
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=5&page=1' > /tmp/cv1.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=5&page=2' > /tmp/cv2.json; python3 -c "import json; a=[c['id'] for c in json.load(open('/tmp/cv1.json'))['history']['conversations']]; b=[c['id'] for c in json.load(open('/tmp/cv2.json'))['history']['conversations']]; assert not (set(a)&set(b)), set(a)&set(b)"

cases.title: sort=oldest reverses the order
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=10&sort=oldest' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); h=d['history']; ls=[c['last_at'] or '' for c in h['conversations']]; assert ls==sorted(ls), ls[:4]; assert h['filter']['sort']=='oldest'"

cases.title: sort=messages is monotonic descending
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=100&sort=messages' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); m=[c['messages'] for c in d['history']['conversations']]; known=[x for x in m if x is not None]; assert known==sorted(known, reverse=True), known[:6]; assert all(x is None for x in m[len(known):]), m[:12]"

cases.title: sort=calls is monotonic descending
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=100&sort=calls' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); c=[x['tool_calls'] for x in d['history']['conversations']]; known=[x for x in c if x is not None]; assert known==sorted(known, reverse=True), known[:6]; assert all(x is None for x in c[len(known):]), c[:12]"

cases.title: the four sorts are advertised to the client
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); keys=[s['key'] for s in d['history']['filter']['sorts']]; assert keys==['newest','oldest','messages','calls'], keys"

cases.title: profile filter narrows and echoes back
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations' > /tmp/cva.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?profile=l2' > /tmp/cvb.json; python3 -c "import json; a=json.load(open('/tmp/cva.json'))['history']; b=json.load(open('/tmp/cvb.json'))['history']; assert b['total']<a['total'], (b['total'],a['total']); assert b['filter']['profile']=='l2'; assert all(c['profile']=='l2' for c in b['conversations'])"

cases.title: search by id narrows to one conversation
cases.cmd: cid=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=1' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["history"]["conversations"][0]["id"])'); curl -s "{{BASE}}/api/conversations?q=$cid" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); h=d['history']; assert h['total']==1, h['total']; assert h['conversations'][0]['id']=='$cid'"

cases.title: an impossible search returns zero, not an error
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?q=zzzz-no-such-conversation-zzzz' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); h=d['history']; assert h['total']==0; assert h['conversations']==[]"

cases.title: page past the end clamps instead of 500ing
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=5&page=99999' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d['history']['filter']; assert f['page']==f['pages'], f"

cases.title: the list is idempotent
cases.cmd: a=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=5' | md5sum); b=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=5' | md5sum); [ "$a" = "$b" ]

cases.title: transcript without cid is 400 JSON
cases.cmd: [ "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages')" = "400" ] && curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages' | python3 -c "import sys,json; assert 'error' in json.load(sys.stdin)"

cases.title: transcript reports its own window honestly
cases.cmd: cid=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=1' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["history"]["conversations"][0]["id"])'); curl -s "{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=$cid" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert {'id','messages','truncated','total','newest'} <= set(d); assert d['id']=='$cid'; assert d['truncated'] == (d['total'] > len(d['messages'])), (d['truncated'], d['total'], len(d['messages']))"

cases.title: transcript messages are in stored (seq) order
cases.cmd: cid=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=1' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["history"]["conversations"][0]["id"])'); curl -s "{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=$cid" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); sq=[m['seq'] for m in d['messages']]; assert sq==sorted(sq), 'transcript is not in append order'; assert len(set(sq))==len(sq), 'duplicate seq'"

cases.title: an unknown cid returns an empty transcript, not a 500
cases.cmd: c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=nope'); [ "$c" = "200" ] && curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=nope' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d['messages']==[]; assert d['total']==0"

cases.cmd: c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=../../etc/passwd'); [ "$c" != "500" ] && curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=../../etc/passwd' | grep -qv 'root:x:'

cases.title: audit message count equals the transcript total
cases.cmd: cid=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=1' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["history"]["conversations"][0]["id"])'); curl -s "{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=$cid" > /tmp/cvm.json; curl -s "{{BASE}}/api/conversations/audit?cid=$cid" > /tmp/cva2.json; python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open('/tmp/cvm.json')); a=json.load(open('/tmp/cva2.json')); assert a['messages']==m['total'], (a['messages'], m['total'])"

cases.title: audit tool counts sum to the reported tool_calls
cases.cmd: cid=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=1' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["history"]["conversations"][0]["id"])'); curl -s "{{BASE}}/api/conversations/audit?cid=$cid" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); s=sum(t['count'] for t in d.get('tools') or []); assert s==(d.get('tool_calls') or 0), (s, d.get('tool_calls'))"

cases.title: daily has a cost per day, no gaps in the window
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); days=d['daily']; assert len(days)>=1; assert all('date' in x and 'cost' in x for x in days); ds=[x['date'] for x in days]; assert ds==sorted(ds), 'daily not chronological'"

cases.title: cache reports hits, misses and savings consistently
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); c=d['cache']; assert {'hit_tokens','miss_tokens','savings'} <= set(c); assert c['hit_tokens']>=0 and c['miss_tokens']>=0; assert c['savings']>=0"

cases.title: /api/usage/totals agrees with stats.totals
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats' > /tmp/us1.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/totals' > /tmp/us2.json; python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('/tmp/us1.json'))['totals']; t=json.load(open('/tmp/us2.json')); assert s['requests']==t['requests'], (s['requests'],t['requests']); assert abs(s['cost']-t['cost'])<0.01"

cases.title: a provider filter narrows without changing shape
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats?provider=deepseek' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d['totals']['requests']>=0; assert {'daily','by_model','by_profile','totals'} <= set(d)"

cases.title: profile-series has one value per day, per profile
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/profile-series' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); n=d['days']; assert len(d['dates'])==n, (len(d['dates']), n); bad=[(p, len(v.get('cost') or [])) for p,v in d['profiles'].items() if len(v.get('cost') or [])!=n]; assert not bad, bad"

cases.title: daily-costs returns a non-empty series
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/daily-costs' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(d['daily_costs'])>0"

cases.title: the usage page renders its tables
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/usage' | python3 -c "import sys,re; h=sys.stdin.read(); assert 'Usage' in h; assert len(re.findall(r'<caption', h))>=1, 'no captions'"

cases.title: routing status reports policy, rules and decisions
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/routing/status' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert isinstance(d['enabled'],bool); assert isinstance(d['policy'],str) and d['policy']; assert isinstance(d['rules'],list); assert isinstance(d['recent_decisions'],list)"

cases.title: routing status covers every configured profile
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/routing/status' > /tmp/rt.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/profiles' > /tmp/pf.json; python3 -c "import json; r=set(json.load(open('/tmp/rt.json'))['per_profile']); p=set(json.load(open('/tmp/pf.json'))['profiles']); assert not (p-r), sorted(p-r)"

cases.title: every routed provider is a configured provider
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/routing/status' > /tmp/rt.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/providers' > /tmp/pv.json; python3 -c "import json; r=set(json.load(open('/tmp/rt.json'))['providers']); p=set(json.load(open('/tmp/pv.json'))['providers']); assert not (r-p), sorted(r-p)"

cases.title: recent decisions also appear in the decision log
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/routing/status' > /tmp/rt.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/provider-decisions?per=50' > /tmp/dl.json; python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('/tmp/rt.json'))['recent_decisions']; l=json.load(open('/tmp/dl.json'))['rows']; assert len(r)>0 and len(l)>0; assert {x.get('provider') for x in r} <= {x.get('provider') for x in l}"

cases.title: provider health summary counts match its own provider list
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/providers/health' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); s=d['summary']; n=len(d['providers']); assert s['total']==n, (s['total'], n); assert s['healthy']+s['degraded']+s['dead']==n, s"

cases.title: failover rows carry from/to/provider
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/providers/failovers' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); rows=d['failovers']; assert isinstance(rows,list); assert all(isinstance(x,dict) and x for x in rows[:5])"

cases.title: provider presets are non-empty and shaped
cases.cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/providers/presets' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); pr=d['presets']; assert isinstance(pr,dict) and pr, 'no presets'; assert all(isinstance(v,dict) for v in pr.values())"
